# sspirial.systems

> sspirial.systems is an independent R&D systems studio and autonomous agents lab. We design local-first, zero-infrastructure systems architectures, lightweight tools, and reactive agent pipelines.

## Navigation & Entry Points

- [/](https://sspirial.systems/): Landing page with simulated command line terminal interface.
- [/projects](https://sspirial.systems/projects): Project Registry Index. Contains deployed prototypes, whitepapers, and versions.
- [/research](https://sspirial.systems/research): Lab/Knowledge File Tree Explorer. Monospaced split-screen browser containing detailed research logs and technical notes.
- [/about](https://sspirial.systems/about): Studio Manifesto, Core Philosophy, Axiomatic Principles, and chronological System Evolution Log.
- [/login](https://sspirial.systems/login): Secure Admin Login (OTP/Magic-Link verification).

## Core Heuristics & Design Axioms

- **Build for $0**: No active monthly infrastructure costs. Database, file storage (embedded base64), and hosting run entirely on serverless and client-side layers.
- **Local-First**: Data belongs to the device. Network synchronization is a convenience layer, not a hard barrier.
- **Agent Organisms**: Systems are modeled as reactive loops of autonomous agents, rather than rigid monolithic code pipelines.

## Developer & Agent API (via Terminal)

The landing page features an interactive terminal console that responds to commands. You can query the system by entering commands:
- `help`: Lists all available commands.
- `status`: Returns system metrics, database connection status, uptime, and host node metadata.
- `manifesto`: Streams the R&D values and core principles.
- `projects`: Returns a formatted index of all projects in the database.
- `projects <name>`: Inspects a specific project node's description and metadata.
- `agents`: Monitors active autonomous R&D subagents and their logs.
- `llms.txt`: Prints this index representation to the console screen.
